notes.title: Don't probe me bro!
notes.content: [p]Strange craft have been spotted stealing the shopping carts. Preventing an alien invasion isn't in your job description, but you don't want to get in trouble if too many go missing. Maybe it's just the dry desert air making folks go a bit crazy? Guess you'll have to investigate next time you have cart duty.[/p]

notes.title: Job Opening at Red Rock Market
notes.content: Excited to launch the Steam page for [b]Sacker[/b] after several months of development! This game was inspired by quality time spent as a front-line retail worker, but with far less breakdancing. Will you be an unapologetic slacker or upstanding employee? Unlike real life, you probably won’t get fired if you hide from customers, or play baseball with rotten fruit on your break. [b]Wishlist today[/b], and put in your application at the Red Rock Market!
